verdict.rationale: Calendar sync is a fair question for an on-call scheduling product like Rootly, so the axis applies. The evidence documents schedules, rotations, overrides, mobile shift swaps, and checking schedules via MCP or AI, but nothing about an iCal/calendar feed or syncing shifts to a personal calendar. Those adjacent schedule features earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, my shifts sync to my personal calendar via a feed so I always know when I'm on the hook
